mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) consistently boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% YoY signals persistent price pressures, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and unemployment rise (UNRATE > 4.0%) indicate economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: The joint INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing market contraction (HOUST < 1600) reduces residential investment and consumer wealth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through diminished spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
